neighbours.label: active words of enabling and control ('enabling', 'empowering', 'controlling' as gerund or modifier); the other side is the passive '-controlled'/'-ulated' form on the − pole
fire: The new chip provides an enabling pulse to the motor driver.
Teachers want an empowering classroom where pupils speak up.
Software for controlling the robot arm is still in testing.
Cheap sensors are a key enabling technology for smart farms.
The firm hired a coach for empowering its junior staff.
He was accused of controlling every detail of the project.
Good roads are an enabling factor for rural trade.
The board is responsible for controlling the budget each year.
quiet: The new chip is enabled by a pulse from the motor driver.
Pupils felt empowered to speak up in the classroom.
The robot arm is controlled by software still in testing.
Smart farms are enabled by cheap sensors and radios.
Junior staff were coached by the firm for a year.
Every detail of the project was controlled by him.
Rural trade grew once the roads were paved.
The budget is checked by the board each year.
